transmit_pause.title: Transmit pause
transmit_pause.description: When enabled, the peripheral pauses for two CAN bit times after successfully transmitting a message before starting the next transmission.

protocol_exception.title: Protocol exception
protocol_exception.description:
When enabled, this causes the operation state to change from Receiver state to Sync state at the next sample point.
When disabled, a recessive "res." bit is treated as a form error, and the FDCAN responds with an error frame.

clock_route.title: Clock routing
clock_route.description:
Choose whether the FDCAN clock goes directly through the divider or through the clock calibration unit.
In calibration mode the CCU can both adjust the clock and report the calibration status.
In bypass mode the CCU can only be used to monitor timing, it does not change the clock.

clock_calibration.title: Clock calibration unit
clock_calibration.description:
Configure the FDCAN Clock Calibration Unit (CCU). When the clock is routed through the CCU, FDCAN1 measures the timing of a reference CAN frame and the CCU calibrates the time-quanta clock for all FDCAN instances.
In BYPASS mode the CCU can still be used to monitor calibration state and timing counters, but it does not influence the FDCAN clock and bit timings.

actions.message: This setting can only be modified via the FDCAN1 instance.

clock_calibration_enable.title: Use clock calibration unit
clock_calibration_enable.description:
In bypass mode, use the CCU to measure and report calibration status (monitoring) while the application keeps full control of the FDCAN1 instance bit timing.
 In calibration mode, use the CCU to perform hardware calibration.

actions.message: This setting can only be modified via the FDCAN1 instance.
At least one calibration type filter must be configured to treat Rx buffer messages as calibration messages.

When using the Clock Calibration Unit (CCU) for a software-driven calibration sequence, all FDCAN instances must be configured in restricted operation mode.
This requirement does not apply when the CCU is used only to monitor calibration status.

time_quanta_per_bit_time.title: Time quanta per bit time
time_quanta_per_bit_time.description:
Total number of small time steps that make up one CAN bit when the clock calibration unit (CCU) is used.
This value is automatically set from FDCAN1 nominal timing ("nominal Time segment 1" + "nominal Time segment 2" + 1) so that the clock calibration unit and the FDCAN bit timing stay consistent.

calibration_field_length.title: Calibration field length
calibration_field_length.description: Length of the calibration field in bits.

actions.message: This field is not configurable when the CCU is not used (neither for calibration nor for monitoring).

min_osc_clk_periods.title: Minimum oscillator clock periods
min_osc_clk_periods.description: Glitch filter for basic calibration: minimum number of oscillator clock periods (OCPM x 32) accepted as "two bit times" between falling edges on RX. It should be set slightly below two nominal CAN bit times at the lowest bitrate.

actions.message: This field is not configurable when the CCU is not used (neither for calibration nor for monitoring).

watchdog_start_value.title: Watchdog start value
watchdog_start_value.description: Start value of the calibration watchdog counter. Set to 0 to disable watchdog.

actions.message: This field is not configurable when the CCU is not used (neither for calibration nor for monitoring).
Enable this option only when Frame format is set to CAN FD with bit rate switching.

For data phase bit rates above 1 Mbps,
it is highly recommended to enable the transmitter delay compensation to prevent bit errors due to transceiver delay.
This field is not configurable when transmitter delay compensation is not enabled.

tx_delay_comp_offset.title: Offset
tx_delay_comp_offset.description: Offset value defining the distance between the measured delay from FDCAN_TX to FDCAN_RX and the secondary sample point.

tx_delay_comp_win_length.title: Window length
tx_delay_comp_win_length.description: Maximum number of time quanta the FDCAN hardware is allowed to lengthen or shorten a bit to perform resynchronization.

enable_timeout_counter.title: Set timeout counter
enable_timeout_counter.description: 16-bit timeout counter that reports timeout conditions for Rx FIFO 0, Rx FIFO 1, and the Tx event FIFO.

oneOf.title: Timeout controlled by the Tx event FIFO

timeout_period.title: Timeout period
timeout_period.description:
Start value of the timeout counter (down-counter). Set to 0 to disable timeout functionality.
The timeout period is specified in number of nominal bit times.

actions.message: This field is not configurable when timeout counter is not enabled.
Using internal timestamp counter with bitrate switching in CAN FD frame format may lead to inaccurate timestamps.

timestamp_prescaler.title: Prescaler
timestamp_prescaler.description: Timestamp counter time unit in multiples of CAN bit times.

actions.message: This field is not configurable when timestamp source is not internal.

timestamp_tick_duration.title: Single tick duration
timestamp_tick_duration.description: The duration of a single tick (increment) of the timestamp counter.

actions.message: This field is not configurable when timestamp counter is not enabled.
Timestamp source set to EXTERNAL (TIMx counter). The related TIMx peripheral must be started before using the timestamp feature.

enable_iso_mode.title: ISO 11898-1 mode
enable_iso_mode.description: Use the CAN FD behavior defined by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 11898-1 standard.

actions.message: ISO 11898-1 mode is enabled by default. Switching to non-ISO CAN FD (Specification V1.0) is only intended for legacy pre-2015 prototypes and may cause interoperability issues and CRC errors with standard ISO 11898-1 CAN FD devices.

enable_rx_fifo_operation_mode.title: Set Rx FIFO operation mode
enable_rx_fifo_operation_mode.description: Change the default behavior of Rx FIFO 0 and Rx FIFO 1.

actions.message: Add at least one filter that stores frames in Rx FIFO 0 or Rx FIFO 1 before enabling a custom  Rx FIFO mode.
This field is not configurable when custom Rx FIFO operation mode is not used.
Enabling the extended ID mask has no effect since no extended ID filters are configured to apply the XIDAM mask.
This field is not configurable when extended ID mask is not enabled.
This field is not configurable when message RAM watchdog is not enabled.

message_ram_watchdog_timeout.title: Message RAM watchdog timeout
message_ram_watchdog_timeout.description: Maximum time allowed between the start of a message RAM access and the READY signal before the watchdog expires and raises the message RAM watchdog interrupt.

actions.message: These Rx FIFO 0 interrupts will never trigger because no filter stores frames in Rx FIFO 0.
This field is not configurable when Rx FIFO 0 new message interrupt is not enabled.
This field is not configurable when Rx FIFO 0 full interrupt is not enabled.
This field is not configurable when Rx FIFO 0 message lost interrupt is not enabled.
This field is not configurable when Rx FIFO 0 watermark interrupt is not enabled.

watermark_rx_fifo_0.title: Watermark level
watermark_rx_fifo_0.description: Level that triggers the Rx FIFO 0 watermark interrupt.

actions.message: This field is not configurable when Rx FIFO 0 watermark interrupt is not enabled.

The interrupt watermark level is set higher than the configured Rx FIFO 0 number, the interrupt will never be triggered.
 Please adjust the watermark level or the Rx FIFO 0 element number.
These Rx FIFO 1 interrupts will never trigger because no filter stores frames in Rx FIFO 1.
This field is not configurable when Rx FIFO 1 new message interrupt is not enabled.
This field is not configurable when Rx FIFO 1 full interrupt is not enabled.
This field is not configurable when Rx FIFO 1 message lost interrupt is not enabled.
This field is not configurable when Rx FIFO 1 watermark interrupt is not enabled.

watermark_rx_fifo_1.title: Watermark level
watermark_rx_fifo_1.description: Level that triggers the Rx FIFO 1 watermark interrupt.

The interrupt watermark level is set higher than the configured Rx FIFO 1 number, the interrupt will never be triggered.
 Please adjust the watermark level or the Rx FIFO 1 element number.
The high priority message interrupt will never be triggered because no filter is configured to receive high priority messages.
